question: How must INGEST represent a structurally complete Layout A transaction when the fixed source statement provides no description glyph evidence?
context: The authorized private fixture set matches the owner's only production statement formats. Layout A reconciles ordered dates, movements, running balances, and controls, but some structurally complete rows have zero description-only candidates. Re-export, out-of-band facts, OCR, neighboring-text borrowing, blanks, and removal of the required layout are not acceptable.
decision: Keep Layout A in v1 and apply DD-INGEST-SOURCE-DESCRIPTION-ABSENCE. A zero-candidate description band emits the typed source_absent_marker evidence state and exact non-financial marker 'Description unavailable in source statement'; unique source text remains source_text and multiple candidates block. The marker flows unchanged into Ledger OriginalDescription, its description fingerprint, and immutable record/get verification.
